sources.title: Port of Los Angeles Container Terminals
sources.notes: Confirms container terminals and intermodal rail capability. Does not confirm live capacity, cut-offs, carrier service or cargo acceptance.

sources.title: Los Angeles International Airport cargo operations indicators
sources.notes: Confirms active cargo operations at LAX. Airline, handler, terminal and shipment-specific acceptance remain required.

sources.title: NSW Ports Port Botany
sources.notes: Confirms three container terminals and dedicated freight-rail connectivity. Terminal operations and live acceptance are external to NSW Ports.

sources.title: Sydney Airport freight and ground handling information
sources.notes: Confirms cargo and ground-handling contacts and freight operators. Specific cargo acceptance remains with airline and handler.

sources.title: Passenger Port of Saint Petersburg cargo-terminal infrastructure
sources.notes: Confirms limited cargo and cargo-passenger berth capability. It is not a general container-port acceptance statement. Enhanced transaction-specific compliance screening is mandatory.

sources.title: Moscow Cargo terminal at Sheremetyevo
sources.notes: Confirms cargo-terminal handling capability. Airline, commodity, route, sanctions and compliance screening remain mandatory.
